title: Sandiganbayan says COA finds court compliant with accounting policies

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Sandiganbayan noted that the Commission on Audit (COA) found the anti-graft court compliant with the state auditors’ accounting policies. The anti-graft court issued the statement on Thursday after media reports said COA had flagged the court over insufficient documentation for the foreign travels undertaken by some of its officials and employees.
